title: Add Window Switcher Dropdown
instructions: Add a QComboBox dropdown next to the menus button that lists all running windows using wmctrl -l. When a window is selected, use wmctrl -a to activate it. Include an auto-refresh timer to keep the list updated.

1784843498.8784008.instruction:
Create src/window_manager_pyqt5.py with a WindowManager class that:
- Has method get_windows() that runs `wmctrl -l` and parses output
- Returns list of dicts with id, desktop, title, name
- Has method activate_window(window_id) that runs `wmctrl -ia <id>`
- Has method refresh() to update the list
- Include error handling if wmctrl is not installed

1784843512.907524.instruction:
Modify panel_pyqt5.py to add a QComboBox window switcher:
- Add it after the menus button (left side)
- Set placeholder text "Windows" or "🪟"
- Connect currentIndexChanged to activate selected window
- Style it to match other panel elements (dark background, white text)
- Set maximum width to prevent it from taking too much space

1784843515.0582113.instruction:
Add a QTimer in Panel.__init__ that refreshes the window switcher dropdown every 2-3 seconds. When refreshing:
- Preserve currently selected window if it still exists
- Update the list with current windows
- Handle case where wmctrl fails gracefully (disable the dropdown)

1784843517.1063051.instruction:
Make the window switcher look beautiful and functional:
- Add an icon (🪟 or similar) before the text
- Truncate long window titles with "..."
- Show desktop number in tooltip or as prefix
- Ensure minimum width so it's usable but doesn't dominate
- Add visual feedback when switching windows
